notes.title: Update 9: Core Update
notes.notes:
Optimizations

 reduced the amount of images loaded to memory each game.


Improved game flow

 in beginning playtime is now only 2 minutes. This reduces greatly the feel of grind but the game is still as challenging. Timer increases 1 minute on every achievement & progress step. This also adds new depth to strategies because you are playing against small score on short time. I know the best part of the game is discovery so I don't want players to get stuck in the beginning.
 the end is also now linked to another event in game.
 the secrets can be discovered from two ways now. The other less convenient but more likely find.
 balloons pass multichoise options instead of doing nothing
 difficulty setting to fine tune the game suitable for you before each round.


Graphics

 imroved UI-graphics.
 background "room" now has more depth every 2nd and 3rd round for variation.
 new improvement round for 90% of the images.
 high detail setting now also gives subtle light passes to Gia.
 high detail setting gives most Gia images also small animated details for the background. Nothing too distracting.
 couple bad images replaced with nice ones.
 the surprise extra images have been changed.
 14 random background character extras that occupy the beach. They can be found basically in Gia images where there was enough room. All these spots are cycled systematically but it's likely you wont see one every round.
 fly squashing is more satisfying.
 no changes to photos or animated icons. I'll just state that so you wont specifically have to search any if you are a veteran player.


Custom skin packages

 videoclip support for custom skin packages. You need to use mp4 format and have your video horizontal but rotated. It is then turned 90 degress in game. Your clip should orient same way as with recording video on your phone vertically and then inspecting that file on computer. Use that as reference. Also you must have png files as well which in this case can be blank.
 idle taunts are more generic now for custom packages and less vulgar so they are less fixed in specific theme.


And that's all for this year, I wish you Happy upcoming Holidays!

notes.title: Update 8: DETAILS!
notes.notes:
For those unfamiliar with What's my gender?, this is the 8th and last large update

Content Updates :

 Surprise bonus content for those who study hard! (if you unlock all styles and poses)
 More Middle game hidden content that helps you battle your challenges
 Big and small Bug Fixes


Customizations :

 You can alternatively play steam music. Tracks automatically change from your steam Music Player
 15 Custom photos can be included in the fullmod image packages replacing porfolio photos in game. Sample images export along with the other samples
 Custom Full Mod has Bg image support. Sample Bg image exports along with the other samples


Graphics :

 Image Effects as fine detail, default:off (normal/HIGH). Makes the game look nice but tougher for your video card so use it if you love it.
 some light & particle details


SPOILER ALERT: "Secret" Second and more Playthroughs :

 "secret" end score has now also a screenshot button that gives you a nice memory to print and hang on your bathroom wall
 There's a special reward system that's active for second and more playthroughs. The rewards can be used to increase end game score and slightly change the way you play.


Even if you played the game through with every update, this one is still worth seeing all the way through so get back to learning!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32802526/c7cc1d4ad720180f9e8d0e96d3d3db4f4907f4a8.png

notes.title: Update 7: The End Game
notes.notes:
Added:

 a new End Game Challenge can be accessed from "secrets"
 Background Room Color Styles - Unlocked by playing enough full rounds
 More UI details
 Loading bar

Changed:

 Fast Forward is now limited to 5 per day. This should encourage to play full rounds.
 options - Particles is merged together with new details and is now called Details
 Painted 18th reward image some more

fixed:

 Porfolio had a mistype in code with > instead of >= so everything was 1 dingdong too expensive, sorry :)
 Some audios were not muted when sound was set to off and some still might. I'll hunt them down later

 Game is more optimized


The update most likely won't affect your current game state but if something is clearly not progressing it might be that you need to reset your game progress from options due to many changes.

This update will wrap the game content together pretty nicely and I will be working on the middle game content some next month to bring the 8th and last update.

notes.title: Update 4: Fix Round
notes.notes:
The challenges are bug free now and safe to play with.

You buy one with the ball cost displayed and if you succeed you gain more balls.

Also I added the small joke challenge, which has a chance to appear every 5th round of play and only with Gia images, so it's quite rare.

Be warned though, some of the most difficult challenges for the "secret balls" are very difficult so think twice before you gamble those balls.

notes.title: Update 4: September Update
notes.notes:
random small challenges. They appear more often with more days in a row.

 unlockable challenges for days 2-4. So you are rewarded for playing daily with opportunity to get more balls.
Some of the challenges require you to use different gadgets to beat them.

 changed words per minute to be more accurate. It's calculated from CPM every 60s. Only correct answers count.

 Added Freemode to display WPM. It's the best place to test your words per minute.


The new content may contain bugs so you may want to wait for fixes later this month or If you don't mind bugs then you can test all the new stuff now.
Either way the old content works the same. There's also secret content that didn't make it to this update. The content makes some challenges easier. It will come later this month with the potential fixes.
Also later this month I'll add a short simple intro animation for the story and a rare joke challenge.

notes.title: Update 3: August Update
notes.notes:
Added new UNLOCKABLE animated thumbnails. Unlocked using scoreboard scores.
 That's right. You'll have to keep learning those words to unlock them! 
 Also gets more difficult with each purchase.

 Added details and more shading work on all Gia images

 Added a special daily typing challenge if you have inserted enough words. Challenge difficulty increases slowly if you play well.

 Added a daily wheel of fortune.

 Added challenge encouraging texts which display as you progress towards current challenge

 Changed full week reward into 4 days in a row reward for game balance reasons.

 Added indication to how many days in a row you have as it's more important than ever

 Added passive gadget: Sleeping pill to skip days and reach day 4 faster.

 Added new details to some of the sprite elements.

 Wager-coin: When used, next 6 corrects in a row give +10 to score if you succeed.

 Time-coin: Freezes time until you've given an answer. Also freezes Pro timer.

 Meditate-coin: Shows success rate for next 5 answers based on your play.

 Recharge-coin: Boosts gadget recharging

 Added coin casting for Wager-coin which is Unlocked from a new pro challenge


This is quite large portion of what I had planned but there are still more things to come with 4th and 5th update.

I've tested everything but if a bug slipped through and you find it before I do then write it in the comment and I'll fix it asap, naturally followed by a proper Bastonade.

I'll start working on a new trailer as the old one is now with new images and other content outdated. Just FYI if you don't own the game yet and wish to see the new images.

Don't forget to look for secrets. Sometimes there are hints so stay sharp. There could be new things there!

notes.title: UPDATE 2: Sweaty Summer Update
notes.notes:
With Options you can now easily create word packs selected from your current words
New blue gadget: Brain - Reveals the word if during play you already got it right at least once.
New blue gadget: Treasury - Drops 1-5 coins. 9% chance to drop a pink ball. 1% chance to drop a blue ball.
stats now also have "coins lost"

For serious learning, the pack creation should come in handy!
If you have too long breaks between plays and start to forget words, you can save your words as a pack if you wish to return to them later,
then reset the current words to start clean.

And come back daily to test all those gadgets ;)

Current updated shop loops go as follows:
cost 3 gadgets loop 2 days: Blink, Scramble
cost 2 gadgets loop 3 days: Money, Binoculars, Brain
cost 1 gadgets loop 4 days: Coffee, Gender, Tissue, Treasury
